title: PHM-ensemble: Scalable and Stable Probabilistic Multiresolution Clustering via Ensemble Density Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2611.32945v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Clustering is a foundational tool for exploratory data analysis across the sciences. We argue that clustering methods should be evaluated along four dimensions: fidelity to the data's underlying structure, interpretability of the recovered groups, stability under data perturbations and algorithmic randomness, and scalability to modern scientific datasets. Yet existing methods rarely satisfy all four criteria. To address this gap, we introduce PHM-ensemble, a general probabilistic framework for multiresolution clustering that estimates the underlying data density by pooling mixture models from an ensemble of fits and subsequently constructs a clustering hierarchy through hierarchical merging of the mixture components. translated_title: PHM-ensemble：基于集成密度估计的可扩展且稳定的概率多分辨率聚类
translated_abstract: 聚类是跨科学领域探索性数据分析的基础工具。我们认为聚类方法应从四个维度进行评估：对数据底层结构的保真度、所恢复群组的可解释性、在数据扰动和算法随机性下的稳定性，以及对现代科学数据集的可扩展性。然而，现有方法很少能同时满足这四项标准。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了PHM-ensemble，这是一个用于多分辨率聚类的通用概率框架，它通过汇集来自集成拟合的混合模型来估计数据的底层密度，随后通过对混合成分的层次化合并构建聚类层次结构。在模拟数据集和MNIST基准测试中，PHM-ensemble与真实标签的一致性达到或超过广泛使用的聚类算法，在多次运行中产生更稳定的结果，并能揭示复杂的底层……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出PHM-ensemble框架，通过集成密度估计汇集多个混合模型并对成分进行层次化合并，实现了同时兼顾保真度、可解释性、稳定性和可扩展性的概率多分辨率聚类。
en_tdlr: PHM-ensemble is a scalable and stable probabilistic multiresolution clustering framework that pools mixture models via ensemble density estimation and hierarchically merges components, matching or outperforming widely used clustering algorithms in fidelity, interpretability, stability, and scalability.
